titles.display: New Britain Machine Company

data.description: Former tool company in Connecticut, USA
data.extract: New Britain Machine Company was a tool company that was headquartered in New Britain, Connecticut. The company started to sell woodworking machines, sockets and drive tools. New Britain was the main supplier for NAPA tools until its closure in 1990. New Britain Machine owned Husky and Blackhawk tools as well as making its own economy-grade tools under the None Better and Mustang names. New Britain Machine was then acquired by the Litton Tool Company on December 22, 1972.
